title: Constant Gamma Clutter
text: Constant gamma clutter simulation, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Geometry} sets Array geometry; {Terrain gamma value (dB)} sets the clutter model parameter, {Earth model} sets the earth shape, {Minimum range of clutter region (m)}, {Maximum range of clutter region (m)}, {Azimuth center of clutter region (deg)}, {Azimuth span of clutter region (deg)}, {Azimuth span of clutter patches (deg)}, {Clutter coherence time (s)} sets the coherence time of clutter, {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the clutter sample rate 1e6, {Pulse repetition frequency (Hz)} sets the pulse repetition frequency 1e4, {Enable PRF selection input} selects predefined PRF, {Source of simulation sample time}, {Output signal format} sets the format of the output, {Number of samples in output}, {Number of pulses in output}, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the system operating frequency 3.0e8, {Effective transmitted power (W)} sets the radar system effective transmitted power, {Radar height (m)} sets the height of radar above surface, {Radar speed (m/s)} sets the radar platform speed, {Radar motion direction (deg)} sets the direction of motion of radar platform, {Sensor mounting angles sensor (deg)} sets the sensor mounting angles, {Enable weights input} enables antenna element weights input port, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System, {Element type} sets the array element types, {Operating frequency range (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of the antenna or microphone element, {Operating frequency vector (Hz)} sets the operating frequency range of custom antenna or microphone elements, {Baffle the back of the element} sets the back response of an Isotropic Antenna element or an Omni Microphone element, {Exponent of cosine pattern} sets the exponents of azimuth and elevation cosine patterns, {Frequency responses (dB)} sets the antenna and microphone frequency response, {Input Pattern Coordinate System} sets the coordinate system of custom antenna pattern, {Azimuth angles (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Elevation angles (deg)} sets the elevation angles of antenna radiation pattern, {Phi Angles (deg)} sets the phi angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Theta Angles (deg)} sets the theta angle coordinates of custom antenna radiation pattern, {Magnitude pattern (dB)} sets the magnitude of combined antenna radiation pattern, {Phase pattern (deg)} sets the custom antenna radiation phase pattern, {MatchArrayNormal} sets the rotate antenna element to array normal, {Polar pattern frequencies (Hz)} sets the polar pattern microphone response frequencies, {Polar pattern angles (deg)} sets the polar pattern response angles, {Polar pattern (dB)} sets the custom microphone polar response zeros, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA, {Element spacing (m)} sets the spacing between array elements 0.5 for ULA arrays, {Array axis} sets the linear axis direction, {Array size} sets the dimensions of URA array, {Element lattice} sets the lattice of URA element positions, {Array normal}, {Radius of UCA (m)} sets the uCA array radius, {Element positions (m)} sets the positions of conformal array elements, {Element normals (deg)} sets the direction of conformal array element normal vectors, {Taper} sets the array element tapers, {Subarray definition matrix} defines elements belonging to subarrays logical, {Subarray steering method}, {Phase shifter frequency (Hz)} sets the subarray phase shifting, {Number of bits in phase shifters} sets the subarray steering phase shift quantization, {Subarrays layout} sets the subarray position specification, {Grid size} sets the dimensions of rectangular subarray grid, {Grid spacing (m)} sets the spacing between subarrays on rectangular, {Subarray positions (m)} sets the positions of subarrays and {Subarray normals} sets the direction of subarray normal vectors. Values come from the instance.
